page.layout: One page of text, single column of verb paradigms (Italian-Latin grammar). Running head at top centre; page number top right. Left margin shows faint show-through only, not transcribed.

main_text.head: Idem Temp. aliter declinatum.
main_text.l: Io Sarėi, & Saria O ego essem
main_text.head: Præt. perfect.
main_text.l: Io Sia státo Vtinam ego fuerim.
main_text.head: Præt. plusquam perfect.
main_text.l: Io Fóssi státo Vtinam ego fuissem.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Some verb forms in the left column (Sarėi, Saréməmo, Siistáto, Sarėbbe) are uncertain due to scan quality; the vowel accents are doubtful.
